title: Retired Judge's Obligation to Preside over the National Commission

content.scenario: The President of the National Commission is absent, and a retired Judge of a High Court is a member of the National Commission. The retired Judge presides over the National Commission in the absence of the President.
content.outcome: The retired Judge of a High Court or a person who has been a Judicial Member must preside over the National Commission in the absence of the President, as per Section 63 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, and perform the duties of the President until the President is able to resume duties.

user_queries: Who presides over the National Commission in the absence of the President?
